objective: Classify the possible two-middle supports or provide sharp separation examples when internally shared pads cannot all be released at once. Distinguish signed binary clauses from positive implications on the two named choices.
status: Proved: With internally mixed two-use pads, the simultaneous two-middle table is realizable exactly when it is closed under lowering the initial or raising the final bit and contains the two uniform states. There are 324 such tables, and all 16 individual middle relations occur at a descending pair of ends.
